text: Carpentering is the process of creating various types of structures such as wooden furniture, cabinets, and doors. In carpentry, one starts with sawing, which is used to cut wooden or metal boards into the desired shape and size. The sawing process begins with a saw, which is a metal blade that is used to cut the wood. After sawing, the wood is then polished to remove any rough edges or imperfections. This process is known as sanding, which involves using a sanding block or a steel plate to smooth out any rough edges or imperfections on the wood. After sanding, the wood is then painted to finish the aesthetic appearance of the piece. Once the wooden or metal board is finished, the next process is sawing, which is used to create the desired shape and size. This process is repeated until the piece is completed. Carpentering can be used to create a wide variety of structures, from small furniture pieces to large structures such as buildings and bridges.
